about: Curated copy the sales tools use when AI is off: what buyers in each kind of business want, what they tried, how the work runs, what to include and leave out, and when to ask for referrals. Plain drafts for the member to edit. No prices, fees, statistics or claims about real businesses live here. Placeholders in braces are filled with the member's own facts.
